Hi Sara — thanks for the PO and the certificate. Quick note from our accounting: to process the PO tax-exempt (and issue a zero-tax invoice) we need a resale certificate that includes the following details on the document itself:

- Buyer name exactly as it appears on the PO (BrightLogistics LLC)
- State for which the exemption applies (e.g., CA resale certificate for California)
- Reseller permit / exemption number (or equivalent)
- A signature or official stamp from your tax department (scan is fine)

The copy you attached looks like a general reseller letter and is missing the state designation and a visible signer/stamp. If your tax team can send a stamped/scanned state-specific certificate (or a completed state form) that would speed up processing. If you prefer, we can send our standard reseller form for BrightLogistics to sign.

Hi Sara — Marissa from Billing here. Thanks for sending the initial docs and the permit number. For our US billing team to mark the invoice as resale/exempt, we need one of the following (accepted formats in order of preference):

1) State-issued resale certificate or completed state exemption form (signed/stamped) listing BrightLogistics LLC and the state (e.g., California Certificate of Resale)
2) Company-signed resale certificate that explicitly names BrightLogistics LLC, includes the reseller permit/permit number, and is signed by an authorized representative (scanned PDF with company stamp is OK)
3) A completed Redwood reseller form (we'll pre-fill your PO/permit info) signed and returned via DocuSign

If your blanket permit number BL-RES-99203 is a state-registered reseller number, we can accept it once we have a signed/scanned certificate that ties the number to BrightLogistics LLC and the relevant state(s). Otherwise, the state form (1) is preferred.

To make this easy, here's a DocuSign link to our reseller form (pre-filled with PO/5871 and your permit number); you can sign and return it: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-resale-template

Also, Neha — for this class of reseller purchase we typically record the EIN on file. Sara, if you can include BrightLogistics' EIN on the returned form, that helps speed IRS and internal audit matching.

Connor — once we have the stamped/signed certificate, billing will finalize the invoice and remove sales tax for the related invoice.

Thanks,
